response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with strong full-stack, systems, and infrastructure credentials, but his resume shows almost no evidence of the core requirements for this GenAI-focused role: no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, multi-agent frameworks, or building production AI systems on major cloud platforms. The only AI-adjacent mention is brief involvement with 'AI-agent infrastructure' and MCP tooling at his current role, which is too vague and recent to establish the required 8+ years of AI-driven solution development.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year engineering career with staff/senior titles across diverse domains
Strong generalist technical breadth (web, mobile, embedded, systems, DevOps/CI-CD)
Recent exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling at current employer
concerns: No demonstrated experience with RAG, vector databases, or LLM evaluation pipelines
No evidence of major cloud platform AI system design (AWS/GCP/Azure AI services)
Lacks track record of leading customer-facing technical discovery or multi-agent framework implementation (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Absence of RAG/vector DB/AI pipeline experience
No demonstrated cloud-based AI system design experience
Deep general engineering seniority and adaptability
